title: 第11章 救美女第12章 给城主女儿吸毒
slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: “原来啊！”
楚琳眼里露出了释怀之意，并没再多想。
郑公子说的很有道理，这次一定要找到百年黄莲精。
“楚小姐，你还真是孝顺，十万大山里面可是危险的很，一个女子就敢上山……”
一路上两人交谈甚欢，十万大山里面药材诸多，但越往里面凶兽也更多，即使是后天境强者也不敢贸然踏入大山里最深处。
更不用说这位楚小姐看上去只有淬体境九层修为。
“这不是有郑公子你这个开脉境强者吗嘛。”
楚琳眼睛里露出一丝调皮的笑，长长的眼睫毛扑闪扑闪的。
一双漂亮的眼睛犹如月牙般，好看又迷人。
郑元一时间也不由看呆住了：“楚小姐你眼睛真漂亮，就像天上的月牙儿。”
呼！
听到这赞美的话楚琳瞬间也不禁一丝羞意上脸。
“谢谢郑公子的赞美，我去那边看看有没有百年黄莲精……”
嗖！
楚琳拿着采药工具跑到了那边的林中。
呵呵！
郑元嘴里发出一道笑声，双修毕竟是两个人的事。
楚琳同意才能进行，但人家可是城主的千金大小姐。
凭什么无缘无故和你双修呢，所以必须要打动楚小姐的芳心。
不过这些自然难不倒郑元，心里早就有了主意。
目前最想的就是想办法把楚琳的面纱摘下。
“楚小姐，小心一点，山中虽然药草很多但野兽，凶兽也不少。”
郑元拿着采药的木铲子也慢慢跟了上去，大声提醒着楚琳。
这里是十万大山外围，野兽很多，毒蛇，猛兽，好在两人都有修为在身，所以不用太担心。
“这是百年洗骨花，对治疗断骨有很好的效果，还是炼制增元丹的主药。”
郑元早就把万草图都记在脑海里了，当看到洗骨花时不由心里一喜，赶紧蹲下用木铲子轻轻地清理旁边杂土。
采药同样是一个技术活，根须最完整的药草药性才能保持最佳。
郑元的父亲就是一个猎人和采药人，郑元以前也跟随一起上过十万大山外围，所以采药更是轻车熟路。
不大一会一株完整无缺的洗骨花就被挖了出来。
百年墨叶莲，能够活血化瘀，更是炼制生肌丹的主药，紫兰叶，祝余草……
郑元只要看到有价值，年份够的药草都挖了出来，心里更是暗暗高兴不已。
就在一抬头时突然看直眼了，那就是不远处的一道苗条曼妙身姿。
楚琳背对着自己，正在寻找百年黄莲精，纤细的腰肢与丰满的臀部形成鲜明对比，越发凸显出臀部那优美的曲线，与背部的线条自然衔接，勾勒出一个完美的S形。
太完美了！
这身材绝对是顶级的，就不是不知面纱下那张俏脸会是如何。
正在弯腰找寻百年黄莲精的楚琳眉头紧锁着。
那就是这么久了，自己连一株十年份的黄莲精都没有发现，更不用说百年黄莲精了。
“不过那位郑公子倒是挺有意思的，人帅气还挺幽默，身上还带着一丝坏坏的气息……”
楚琳心里暗暗想着，当然最主要的是郑元救了自己的娘亲。
所以好感度直线上升，还有就是揍王远滕时的样子貌似还挺帅的。
俗话说得好，男人不坏，女人不爱，楚琳对郑元也有了一丝兴趣。
content_en:
"It turns out!"
Chu Lin's eyes showed relief and she didn't think much more about it.
What Young Master Zheng said makes sense. This time we must find the century-old Huanglian Essence.
"Miss Chu, you are really filial. It is very dangerous in Shiwanda Mountain. A woman dares to go up the mountain..."
The two of them chatted happily along the way. There were many medicinal materials in the Shiwan Mountain, but there were more ferocious beasts the further inside, even those who were in the acquired realm did not dare to step into the deepest part of the mountain rashly.
Not to mention that this Miss Chu looks like she is only at the ninth level of Body Tempering Realm.
"Isn't this Mr. Zheng, a strong person in the Pulse Opening Realm?"
A mischievous smile appeared in Chu Lin's eyes, and her long eyelashes fluttered.
A pair of beautiful eyes are like crescent moons, beautiful and charming.
Zheng Yuan couldn't help but be stunned for a moment: "Miss Chu, your eyes are so beautiful, like the crescent moon in the sky."
Phew!
When Chu Lin heard this compliment, she couldn't help but feel a trace of shame on her face.
"Thank you Mr. Zheng for your compliments. I'll go there to see if there is a hundred-year-old yellow lotus essence..."
Whoosh!
Chu Lin ran to the forest over there with her medicine-picking tools.
hehe!
Zheng Yuan burst into laughter. After all, dual cultivation is a matter for two people.
Chu Lin can only proceed with her consent, but she is the daughter of the city lord.
Why should I practice double cultivation with you for no reason? So I must impress Miss Chu.
However, these naturally did not trouble Zheng Yuan, and he already had an idea in his mind.
What she wants most right now is to find a way to take off Chu Lin's veil.
"Miss Chu, be careful. Although there are many medicinal herbs in the mountains, there are also many wild and vicious beasts."
Zheng Yuan slowly followed up with a wooden shovel for picking herbs, reminding Chu Lin loudly.
This is the outskirts of Shiwan Mountain, and there are many wild beasts, including poisonous snakes and ferocious beasts. Fortunately, both of them have good cultivation, so there is no need to worry too much.
"This is a century-old bone-washing flower. It has a very good effect on treating broken bones. It is also the main medicine for refining the Yuan-Zeng Dan."
Zheng Yuan had already memorized all the sketches in his mind. When he saw the bone-washing flower, he couldn't help but feel happy. He quickly squatted down and gently cleaned the dirt next to it with a wooden shovel.
Collecting medicinal herbs is also a technical task. Only the roots with the most complete medicinal properties can maintain the best properties.
Zheng Yuan's father is a hunter and herb gatherer. Zheng Yuan has also gone to the outskirts of Shiwanda Mountain with him before, so he is very familiar with collecting herbs.
After a while, an intact bone-washing flower was dug out.
The century-old black leaf lotus can promote blood circulation and remove blood stasis. It is also the main medicine for refining muscle-building pills, purple orchid leaves, Zhu Yucao...
As long as Zheng Yuan saw that valuable and old herbs were dug out, he would be secretly happy.
When he raised his head, he suddenly saw a slender and graceful figure not far away.
Chu Lin turned her back to herself, looking for the century-old yellow lotus essence. Her slender waist and plump buttocks formed a sharp contrast, highlighting the graceful curves of her buttocks, which naturally connected with the lines of her back, outlining a perfect S shape.
It's perfect!
This figure is definitely top-notch, but I don’t know what that pretty face will look like under the veil.
Chu Lin, who was bending down to look for the centuries-old yellow lotus spirit, frowned.
It's been so long, and I haven't even discovered a ten-year-old Huanglianjing, let alone a hundred-year-old Huanglianjing.
"But Mr. Zheng is quite interesting. He is handsome, humorous, and has a bit of bad vibes about him..."
Chu Lin secretly thought, of course, the most important thing is that Zheng Yuan saved her mother.
So the favorability level skyrocketed, and Wang Yuanteng looked quite handsome when he beat him up.
As the saying goes, if a man is not bad, a woman will not love her. Chu Lin also has a slight interest in Zheng Yuan.
